name: costmaxxing
description: Shows what your Claude Code usage would save on open-weight models, live under the prompt

team.title: Team
team.description: Optional. Your team's name on costmaxxing.dev, as in npx costmaxxing <team>. Usage counts then go to costmaxxing.dev/<team>.

server.title: Team server
server.description: Optional. A self-hosted costmaxxing serve, like http://gateway.local:8787. Leave empty to use costmaxxing.dev for a team, or to keep everything on this machine.

token.title: Team token
token.description: Optional. The token the team server was started with.

user.title: Your name
user.description: Optional. How the team server lists you.
